evidence: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) directives
cells.rationale: China has made 5G a national strategic priority with massive state-backed investment and a clear roadmap for 6G leadership, including setting global standards.

evidence: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (MIC) 6G R&D initiatives
cells.rationale: Japan aims for technological independence and leadership in specific 6G areas, with strong government-industry collaboration and dedicated research consortia.

evidence: Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) 6G R&D plans
cells.rationale: South Korea, a 5G pioneer, has an aggressive national strategy to lead 6G commercialization and standardization, backed by significant public and private R&D.

evidence: Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) Open RAN initiatives
cells.rationale: Taiwan focuses on leveraging its semiconductor strengths to contribute to 5G applications and Open RAN, with a strategic interest in future network components rather than overall system leadership.

evidence: Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) 6G funding
cells.rationale: Germany prioritizes industrial 5G applications and has launched a dedicated national platform with substantial funding to drive 6G research and development.

evidence: Government support for industrial 5G use cases

evidence: Private sector innovation in network security

cells.rationale: India has an ambitious vision for indigenous 5G/6G technology development, aiming for self-reliance and global contribution, backed by a national 6G roadmap.

evidence: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED) 5G initiatives

evidence: Belgian Institute for Postal services and Telecommunications (BIPT) 5G spectrum allocation

evidence: Ministry of Information and Communications (MIC) 5G strategy
